draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: The register's Spalding remodel of the Grosvenor house: 'brick block with steep hip/mansard roof, dormers, tall chimneys, full-height swell bay, projecting gabled wing', drawn as a steep hip with dormers over the 2½B body, the sheet's frame bay as a projection. The 1904 Blue Book lists W. G. Hibbard Jr. at 1637, so the Spalding name is the one provisional association the census keeps; T-1870 rules. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 2719449683 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
